title: Jezero crater mineral distribution (CRISM + CTX)
description: Color overlay highlighting minerals: green = carbonates, red = olivine sand. Derived from CRISM and CTX on MRO.
limitations: Geographic bounds are approximate. The source is a publication RGB figure, not a map-projected science product.
The figure includes its own grayscale basemap, so it will not pixel-match Viking or THEMIS.
Not a quantitative mineral abundance map.
Coverage is limited to the Jezero crater region.
